meta.title: Bonjour — Learn French that you can actually use
meta.description: A premium French-learning platform for adults. Real-life situations, evidence-based progress, and clear next steps.

landing.headline: Learn French you can actually use.
landing.subheadline: Bonjour helps adults build real communicative ability — not just vocabulary lists. Every step is tied to something you can do in French.
landing.differenceBody: We focus on can-do goals, real-life tasks, and evidence of what you can actually perform — not streaks or points.
landing.howStep5: Move to the next clear step

0.title: Welcome
0.description: Tell us a little about yourself so we can personalise your path.

1.title: Why are you learning French?
1.description: Select all that apply. This helps us prioritise real situations.

2.title: Which situations matter most?
2.description: We will focus practice on the contexts you actually need.

placement.title: Placement
placement.subtitle: We collect evidence of what you can already do. There is no pass or fail.

profile.title: Your learning profile
profile.subtitle: Based only on the evidence collected so far. Nothing is invented.
profile.levelNote: This is a provisional estimate from a short assessment. It will be refined as you learn.
profile.evidenceNote: Statuses reflect only what was observed. « Not assessed » means we have no evidence yet.

dashboard.title: What should you do now?
dashboard.allDone: You have demonstrated all current goals
dashboard.allDoneBody: More scenarios will be added. For now, you can review what you have completed.

learn.notFound: This learning goal was not found.
learn.selfAssessPrompt: Based on what you practised, can you do this now?
learn.feedbackNote: This is a self-review. It is clearly labelled and is not an automated or expert evaluation.

progress.title: Your progress
progress.subtitle: Only demonstrated abilities are shown. Nothing is invented.
progress.noneYet: No goals demonstrated yet. Start from the dashboard.
progress.note: Progress is based on evidence you provided — including self-review where labelled as such.

auth.subtitle: Account access for Bonjour.
